name: AUTODOOR_ST_CLOSED
meaning: SetState 0: anim 2, no collision change; Update: opens (2) when occupied (inferred)

name: AUTODOOR_ST_OPEN
meaning: SetState 1: anim 4; Update: when no longer occupied re-enables collision and closes (3) unless a body is in the way (inferred)

name: AUTODOOR_ST_OPENING
meaning: SetState 2: anim 3 and SetCollision(0); Update: on anim end -> 1 (inferred)

name: AUTODOOR_ST_CLOSING
meaning: SetState 3: anim 1 and SetCollision(1); Update: on anim end -> 0 (inferred)
